Resolves #20142

Updates all six `lockedColumns` whitebox e2e specs in `test/playwright/e2e/grid/` to request `{ page, neuralLink }` in `test.beforeEach` so `neuralLink` routes `**/neo-config.json*` to `ws://127.0.0.1:${aiConfig.port}` before `page.goto('/examples/grid/lockedColumns/')` executes, and adds `assertUnnavigatedBeforeNeuralLinkRoute(page)` in `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs` (with unit coverage in `test/playwright/unit/test/stopSpawnedBridge.spec.mjs`) so any spec that navigates `page` in `beforeEach` before `neuralLink` initializes fails immediately even on default `:8081`.

`agent-preflight: not hosted here; baseline husky pre-commit checks (secrets, shorthand, derived-domain, whitespace, jsdoc-types, ticket-archaeology, block-alignment, fixed-sleeps, parse) ran.`

Evidence: L3 (live Playwright whitebox e2e execution of all 6 `lockedColumns` specs on private `NEO_NL_PORT=18942` + unit spec) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3). Residual: none.

Micro-review eligible: test-only — updates 6 e2e `test.beforeEach` signatures in `test/playwright/e2e/grid/` and adds a pre-navigation guard in `test/playwright/fixtures.mjs` with unit coverage in `test/playwright/unit/test/stopSpawnedBridge.spec.mjs`.

# PR Micro-Review

**Class:** mechanical. Test-only harness ordering: six e2e `beforeEach` signatures plus a fail-fast guard in the shared fixture. No product, contract or config surface.

**Verdict:** Approved

**Glance:** The six `lockedColumns` specs now request `neuralLink` in `beforeEach`, so the `neo-config.json` route exists before `page.goto`. A fixture guard fails any spec that navigates first. Verified at exact head `fae4161a92` (CI green; rollup 45 pass, 1 skip), using a private `NEO_NL_PORT=18943` and my Brain clone:
(1) Every test connected in every run: two six-spec batches, eight GridViewFocus solo runs and four shorter batches, with zero `waitForSession` timeouts. Each batch passed 9/10. The red was GridViewFocus's blur arm both times ("blur clears the pointer modality class").
(2) That red predates this PR. At base `79dd27e972`, with the example's `neo-config.json` pointed at the private port (reverted after), the same batch failed the same assertion in 1 of 2 runs. It is filed as #20146, mine, since I authored that spec. The mechanism is a stale stamp from the first region, which lets the final `blur()` race the last click's in-flight `DomAccess.focus`.
(3) The guard fires live. A throwaway spec whose `beforeEach({page})` navigates and whose test requests `neuralLink` failed with the guard's message at `fixtures.mjs:119`. The spec is deleted.
(4) What I looked for and did not find: another spec the guard would newly red. A hook/fixture scan over all 789 head specs (125 use `neuralLink`) finds no hook that navigates `page` without `neuralLink`. The same scan at base finds exactly these six, which is the positive control.
(5) AC-2 places the call before `await routeConfig(context)`; at head it follows it. `routeConfig` only registers a route and never navigates, so `page.url()` reads the same either way.
Bounded repair: the diff touches only the six named specs, the fixture and its unit spec.

**Findings:** None.
